signal: AppVault won Best Comprehensive Solution in talent acquisition at the 2025 HR Technology Awards and is sponsoring UNLEASH America 2026, pushing its AI recruitment marketing suite

email.body1:
Alex, saw AppVault won Best Comprehensive Solution at the HR Tech Awards and is sponsoring UNLEASH America 2026.

That kind of recognition and event push usually drives more accounts worth pursuing than the team can work before interest cools. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for AppVault off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Alex, quick follow-up for AppVault.

With award momentum and conference season driving interest, pipeline targets usually climb faster than the team can cover. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings AppVault needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Alex, last bit of proof for AppVault.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how AppVault's reply rate likely compares to other HR tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Alex, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and conference season is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a recruitment-tech sales motion? I will tailor it to AppVault either way.
